trials.claim: Sellers promise all future Standard, Premium and Team plan updates are included
trials.claimQuote: All future Standard (Tier 1), Premium (Tier 2), Team (Tiers 3, 4) plan updates
trials.reasoning: The exhibits only show per-minute and separate Organization minute charges; neither addresses whether future Standard, Premium, or Team plan updates are included, and no supporting terms exhibit is shown.

exhibits.quote: You can keep using Tough Tongue AI at your plan's add-on rate: Starter is $0.1333/min and Pro is $0.11/min.
exhibits.argument: Ongoing per-minute charges undermine the promise that all future plan updates are included at no extra cost.

exhibits.quote: I purchased **500 minutes for Personal Use**, but if you want to use the product for an Organization, you apparently need to purchase minutes separately again.
exhibits.argument: Separate paid minutes for Organization use contradicts unlimited inclusion across Standard, Premium and Team plans.

trials.claim: Sellers promise AI agents that handle live calls, run demos, coach reps and can be deployed anywhere
trials.claimQuote: Build AI agents that handle live calls, run demos, and coach reps—then deploy them anywhere
trials.reasoning: Reviews report the video avatar not working properly and Hybrid Avatar compatibility issues on iOS mobile browsers, materially limiting the promised demo and deploy-anywhere capability despite the vendor's marketing.

exhibits.quote: The problems start when I add a **video avatar**. Once I enable the video avatar, it simply does not work properly anymore.
exhibits.argument: Video avatar failure undermines the promise that agents can run demos and be deployed anywhere.

exhibits.quote: I noticed some compatibility and usability issues when using Hybrid Avatar on an iOS mobile browser.
exhibits.argument: Mobile browser incompatibility contradicts the claim of deploy-anywhere live call agents.

exhibits.quote: Calls your leads, qualifies them, demos your product with slides and screen sharing, handles objections, and books meetings.
exhibits.argument: This quote confirms agents handle live calls and run demos with slides and screen sharing.

exhibits.quote: Most platforms lock you into one channel. We deploy on phone calls, video meetings, and inside your own product.
exhibits.argument: This quote confirms agents can be deployed anywhere across phone, video and in-product.

trials.claim: Sellers promise ability to create AI agents to handle repeat conversations and coaching
trials.claimQuote: Tough Tongue AI lets you create AI agents to handle repeat conversations and coach you through the ones only you can have.
trials.reasoning: A buyer repeatedly received errors when trying to create a scenario, and another reported lag and emotion tags being read aloud, directly undercutting the promised creation and coaching conversation experience.

exhibits.quote: We tried several times to create a scenario and each time got an error.
exhibits.argument: Repeated creation errors contradict the promise that users can create AI agents for conversations and coaching.

exhibits.quote: I noticed lag on some responses, and in my custom scenario the agent was reading emotion tags aloud ("enthusiastic," "curious") along with the actual dialogue, which broke the immersion.
exhibits.argument: Lag and broken dialogue undermine the promise of agents handling repeat conversations and coaching.

exhibits.quote: Some conversations, the AI handles for you. Others, it makes sure you're ready.
exhibits.argument: This quote confirms AI handles repeat conversations for you and coaches you for others.

exhibits.quote: Tough Tongue AI lets you spin up AI conversation scenarios for sales practice, interviews, coaching, lead-qualification calls, and more in seconds
exhibits.argument: This buyer confirms the product creates AI agents for repeat conversations and coaching use cases.

trials.claim: Sellers promise custom AI agents can be built from recordings, decks and docs with no engineering required
trials.claimQuote: Build custom AI agents from recordings, decks, and docs using Scenario Studio—no engineering required
trials.reasoning: The vendor describes building agents in plain language and a buyer reports success using only a user guide; needing to read a manual is not engineering, and the isolated voice-cloning save issue does not negate document-based agent building.

exhibits.quote: OK, read the fecking manual, basically, because it shows you how to set up the bots correctly.
exhibits.argument: Need to study a manual to set up bots correctly contradicts no engineering required.

exhibits.quote: Voice cloning wouldn't save for us, and the Partner confirmed it is reviewing the save flow and validation requirements.
exhibits.argument: Broken save flow requiring vendor fix undermines easy no-engineering custom agent building.

exhibits.quote: Scaffold from Claude Code, remix a proven template, or just describe it in plain language.
exhibits.argument: This quote confirms custom agents can be built in plain language with no engineering required.

exhibits.quote: Armed with nothing more than a user guide the agent did a much better job than I myself can do!
exhibits.argument: This buyer confirms an agent was built from docs alone and performed successfully.
